arraia:
Use the attached original 2D illustrated creature atlas as strict identity AND ART STYLE reference. Create EIGHT transition poses of the SAME REED MANTA for a short side lunge. Keep painted blue-turquoise body, amber eye, olive leaf fins with golden veins, orange-gold small dorsal spines and thin flexible stem tail ending in reed leaves. Exactly original hand-painted RPG sprite style and selective outline, not 3D, not plastic, not pixel art.
Transparent PNG, exactly 1536x1024, UNIFORM 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equally sized cells 384x512. One complete animal in each cell. NO water, splashes, foam, glow, shadows, ground, scenery, grid, labels or duplicate silhouettes. Large clear margin 40px; tail and fin tips never cross a cell edge.
CAMERA and pose orientation stay RIGHT PROFILE with top slightly visible, like original second row. SAME head/body scale and body center at cell (192,345) in ALL EIGHT CELLS including second row. Body stays in place; in-game movement handles the actual translation. All frames face right. Do not rotate a sprite or change the camera. Changes must be anatomical fin/torso/tail poses.
Frame1: low resting profile, fins partially spread, tail relaxed backward to left.
Frame2: anticipation, fins fold slightly upward and backward along body, head dips 10px, tail curls upward.
Frame3: deepest preparation, fins drawn close to torso, body compressed slightly (same body mass), tail curves into S.
Frame4: impulse, broad fin downstroke begins, head/body level, tail starts straightening.
Frame5: strike, fins swept backward tightly along body for a streamlined lunge, snout clearly forward at right.
Frame6: follow through, fins begin opening, tail flexes down from the impulse.
Frame7: brake, fins spread outward and curve up, torso lifts slightly, tail returns to curved rest.
Frame8: returns to same low resting RIGHT PROFILE of frame1. Finish should connect to the existing walk cycle, no jump in size, body height or camera.
Keep transitions fluid with recognizably the same animal. No floating detached fins, no additional animals, no built-in attack effects.
valvula:
Create 8 animation poses for the WATER VALVE guardian in the attached atlas. Preserve its exact hand-painted 2D fantasy RPG sprite art, stone and bronze palette, circular mechanism design, eight stone segments with engraved glyphs, blue fluid lens and four small fins. NO conversion to 3D, no photorealistic rendering, no low-poly, no new design or face.
Output transparent PNG 1536x1024, uniform 4 columns x 2 rows, one complete guardian per 384x512 cell. Same fixed elevated three-quarter camera as the original first row, same diameter, same center of the ring at (192,340) within every cell. Do not turn the whole ring, flip it vertically or change its geometry. Leave 40px margin, no text, grid, ground or shadows. No outgoing beam or splash: those are independent effects in game.
Reading order, 8 phases of a water-shot attack:
1 floating neutral ring, quiet rotating blue pool.
2 first pressure buildup: blue water tightens inward in a spiral, stone pieces still connected.
3 pressure builds: brighter compressed lens, bronze bands stressed subtly.
4 peak anticipation: compact intensely blue central lens, fins tilt slightly back.
5 discharge: center opens forward to the right, small bright core, slight recoil of the ring; NO jet outside ring.
6 follow-through: lens settles with concentric ripples, fins relaxing.
7 recovery: water widens and brightness reduces, ring returns to neutral balance.
8 neutral floating pose matching frame1; fluid pattern continues coherently.
Maintain ring center, scale and perspective in every frame, only animate water pressure, a few pixels of suspension and the small moving fins. Same approved illustrated 2D sprite, not plastic or 3D. No duplicate creatures inside a cell, no disconnected pieces.
